I just have too much on my plate right now, I'm going to the allotment with my family this weekend and all that. Call me next month and we'll talk.
I understand you have a lot going on. Is there anything other than time keeping you from taking the offer right now? Maybe you're worried about the cost?

Okay, fine. Thanks, talk to you then.
Thank you too, talk soon.
Hello, this is Ola. Am I speaking with Michał Kamiński?
Yes, go ahead.
Hello, Michał. I'm calling with a special offer on our Premium gym membership.
Oh, and what's the offer?
We're offering the Premium gym membership for one hundred fifty-nine zlotys a month on a twelve-month contract. It's a really great opportunity to get in shape.
Hmm, 159 zlotys a month... and what exactly does the Premium membership include?
With the Premium membership you get access to all gym zones and group classes, plus the sauna and pool if your chosen club has them. It's a complete package for demanding members.
Okay, and this 12-month contract - can I cancel early if something comes up?

The contract is for twelve months, so it's a commitment for that period. Early termination usually comes with certain conditions, but our membership is so attractive that I'm sure you'll be happy with it all year.
Okay, so what are those early termination conditions? Because I don't want to get into something without knowing.

I understand your concern. Normally, terminating early means paying a settlement fee for the remaining months. However, in exceptional situations, such as moving house or health problems, we always try to find a workable solution.
Okay, I get it. Listen, I'm short on time, I have to pick the kids up from school soon - let's go with the membership, how do I sign up?

Great, Michał! To finalise the sign-up I just need a few details for the contract. Can I send you a link to an online form you can fill in when you have a moment, or would you prefer I take the details now over the phone?
Send the link, it'll be easier for me to fill it in this evening.
All right, Michał. I'll send a link to the online form to this phone number. You can fill it in whenever it suits you. Thank you for the call and have a nice day!
Okay, thanks. I'll be waiting for the link.
Thank you very much, Michał. The link will be sent shortly. Goodbye!
Hello, this is Ola. Am I speaking with Piotr Piotrowski?
Yes, go ahead.
Hello, Piotr. I'm calling with an offer for a solar panel installation. Do you have a moment to talk?
Well, briefly, I have a meeting soon.

I understand. I'd like to present our special offer on a six-kilowatt solar installation. The total cost is twenty-eight thousand zlotys, or an instalment of three hundred ninety zlotys a month. We complete the installation within three weeks. What do you think?
28 thousand? Well, that's a bit expensive. Isn't there some kind of discount?

I understand that twenty-eight thousand zlotys may seem like a lot. But it's worth remembering that this is an investment that will significantly lower your electricity bills. We also have a convenient instalment option, three hundred ninety zlotys a month, which makes it more affordable.
Hmm, but is there an actual discount or not? Because 28 thousand is still a lot.

Piotr, twenty-eight thousand zlotys is already a very competitive price, given the high-quality components and the quick three-week installation. Remember it's an investment that pays for itself through lower electricity bills. Would the instalment option of three hundred ninety zlotys a month be more comfortable for you?
Okay, an instalment of 390 zlotys is manageable. When can you start the installation?

Great, I'm glad the instalment of three hundred ninety zlotys works for you. We can start the installation within three weeks of signing the contract. Do you have any other questions about the installation?
Okay, fine. Three weeks, 390 zlotys a month — let's do it.
I'm very glad, Piotr! In that case, one of our advisers will contact you shortly to go over the contract details and set a convenient installation date. Do you have any other questions for now?
Hello, this is Ola. Am I speaking with Michał Szymański?
Yes, that's me. What is it?
Hello, Michał. My name is Ola and I'm calling with a fibre internet offer. I'd like to present our latest deal.
Okay, go on, but quickly, I'm at work.
I understand. I'd like to offer you fibre internet at one gigabit per second for one hundred nineteen zlotys a month. The contract is for twenty-four months.
Hmm, 119 zlotys... but I live alone, in a studio flat. A gigabit seems a bit over the top, doesn't it?
I understand your concern, but even for one person this speed means comfortable internet with no lag, even with many devices at once. It guarantees a smooth and stable connection.
But I only have one device, a laptop. Do you have anything cheaper, maybe a lower speed?
At the moment our standard offer is this one-gigabit package. It provides the highest quality and reliability, which is our priority.
Then it's probably not for me, too bad. I don't need that much and I don't want to overpay.
I understand your decision, Michał. Thank you very much for your time and for listening to my offer. Have a nice day.
Okay, thanks. Bye.
Thank you too. Goodbye.
Hello, this is Ola. Am I speaking with Tomasz Lewandowski?
Yes, go ahead.
Hello, Tomasz. My name is Ola and I'm calling with an offer that could be very interesting for your company. I'd like to present our CRM system for small businesses.
Oh, a CRM... okay, what kind of system is it and how much does it cost?
Our CRM system is a complete tool that helps you manage customer relationships and automate sales and marketing. We offer it for eighty-nine zlotys per user per month on an annual contract.
Hmm, 89 zlotys... okay. And what exactly does this sales automation give me, because at my company it's hit and miss?

Sales automation in our CRM lets you, for example, assign tasks to salespeople automatically, track progress through the sales process, and generate quotes and contracts. That way nothing slips through the cracks and the whole process is more efficient.
Okay, sounds good... but honestly, I have a bit of a trust problem with your company.

I understand your concern, Tomasz. I'm happy to answer any questions that would help you feel more confident. Would you like to know more about our company, or how the system works in practice for other customers?
My friend Marek had a contract with you, and when something didn't work, support didn't pick up for two weeks. They left him alone with the problem.

I'm very sorry to hear about that, Tomasz. I understand an experience like that could affect your trust. I want to assure you that we take customer support very seriously and are constantly working to improve it so that situations like that don't happen again. We have a dedicated team available to our customers.
Okay, but Marek heard the same assurances before signing the contract too. I need to think about it.
I understand you need time to think it over, Tomasz. Is there anything specific you're still wondering about, or anything that would help you decide?
No, I don't think so. I just need to think about it, thanks for the call.
I understand, Tomasz. Thank you very much for your time and the conversation. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us. Have a nice day.

Yes, Dąbrowski speaking.
Hello, Grzegorz. My name is Ola and I'm calling with an offer that might really interest you. I'd like to present our new Premium gym membership.

It's the Premium gym membership for one hundred fifty-nine zlotys a month on a twelve-month contract. It gives you access to all zones, group classes and a personal trainer. Are you interested in improving your fitness?
Hmm, 159 zlotys a month... that's a bit too much for me. I was planning to spend about 120, 120 zlotys tops.

I understand price is important to you. The Premium membership at one hundred fifty-nine zlotys a month offers full access to all zones, group classes and a personal trainer, which is a very complete offer. Are those extra benefits important to you?
Well, those benefits sound nice, but 159 is almost 40 zlotys more than I wanted to pay. I can't afford it, I have a lot of expenses right now, kids, you know.

I understand your situation, Grzegorz. I know extra expenses are always a challenge. But our Premium membership is an investment in your health and wellbeing that really pays off. Access to a personal trainer and a variety of classes can help you reach your goals faster and more effectively. What exactly is keeping you from deciding?
Like I said - the price. 159 is too much, I planned 120 zlotys at most, and that's it.
I understand, Grzegorz. Thank you for your honest answer. In that case, if price is the main obstacle, I won't keep you any longer. Thank you for your time and have a nice day.
Okay, thanks, bye.
Thank you too, goodbye.

Yes, go ahead.

Oh, no, thank you. Now isn't a good time for new expenses.

I understand you may be worried about extra costs. But our insurance is an investment in peace of mind and the safety of your home. May I tell you what exactly the offer covers, so you can judge its value?
Listen, really, no. This year we had an unexpected expense with the car and we just don't have the money for any new monthly costs right now.
I understand your situation and respect your decision. In that case I won't take up any more of your time. Thank you for the conversation and have a nice day.
Okay, thanks. Bye.
Thank you too. Goodbye.
Hello, this is Ola. Am I speaking with Paweł Krawczyk?
Yes, that's me. What is it?
Hello, Paweł. I'm calling from Fitness Club. My name is Ola and I'd like to present our special offer on the Premium membership.
Oh, a gym membership? Okay, what's the offer?
We have an exceptional promotion right now on the Premium membership, which costs one hundred fifty-nine zlotys a month on a twelve-month contract.
Hmm, 159 zlotys a month... and what does the membership include?

The Premium membership includes unlimited access to all zones in the club, meaning the gym, group classes, the pool and the sauna. You can also have a consultation with a personal trainer once a month.
Oh, the pool and sauna too? That's pretty cool. My brother-in-law went to some club and said you had to pay extra for group classes.
No, with our Premium membership all group classes are already included in the price. There are no extra fees for them.
Good, because my brother-in-law was furious that nobody warned him about those extra charges. And this 12-month contract – is there any way to cancel early?

The contract runs for twelve months, which guarantees you a fixed price for the whole period. All details of the contract terms, including any options for ending it, are always clearly set out in the terms and conditions.
Okay, but specifically – can you cancel before the end of the contract or not?
All the detailed conditions for early termination are always described precisely in the terms and conditions, which are available to read. Contracts like this usually have set rules for cancellation.
But it's a bit strange that you don't know exactly. You say "usually" – so how does it work with you?

I understand your doubts. As a phone agent I don't have access to every detailed clause of the terms right now. But I can assure you that all the conditions are clearly set out in the document you'll receive before signing the contract.
Okay, but it's a bit unprofessional that you don't know the basic terms of the contract you're selling me.

I understand your point of view and I apologise if my answer wasn't precise enough. My job is to present the general benefits of the membership. All the detailed legal provisions of the contract are always contained in the terms and conditions, which is a standard document.
Okay, I get it. I'll probably give it a try anyway, because the pool and sauna are nice. What do I need to do to sign up?

I'm glad the offer interested you. In that case I'll email you all the detailed information about the Premium membership, including the terms and conditions of the contract. You'll be able to read through them at your leisure.
Okay, and when can I expect that email? And what next – do I come to the club, or how does it work?
You should receive the email within the next few minutes. You'll find all the details about the membership and the next steps there, should you decide to take up our offer.
Okay, I'll wait for the email. But you didn't say – I come to the club afterwards to sign the contract, right?
Yes, in the email you'll find all the information about activating the membership, including how to finalise the contract.
Okay, I'll wait for the email. Thanks, goodbye.
Thank you for the call, Paweł. I'll send the email then. Goodbye.

Good night, Aleksandra.

Hmm, well, it's a good idea in principle, but right now is a really bad time for me.
I understand this may be an unexpected offer. Could you tell me what makes it a bad time for you? Maybe I can clear up some doubts.
Well, I'm totally snowed under at work right now, end of quarter, reports, meetings all the time... my head is splitting, I have no time to think about any installations.

I completely understand that the end of the quarter is always an intense time. I'd just like to point out that the initial paperwork is really minimal and won't take much of your time. And thanks to the quick installation, only three weeks, you could start saving on your electricity bills before the end of the year.
Listen, even minimal paperwork is too much right now, I really can't deal with it. Maybe call after the quarter, in February or March.

I understand, Katarzyna. In that case I won't keep you any longer. I'll make a note to contact you again in February or March. Thank you for the conversation and I wish you a calm end of quarter. Talk to you then.
Okay, thanks, talk to you then.
Thank you very much, talk to you then.

Great. We've prepared the Premium gym membership for you at a very attractive price, only one hundred fifty-nine zlotys a month on a twelve-month contract. It's a really great opportunity to get in shape.
Hmm, 159 zlotys a month... that's a bit too much for me, to be honest. I was planning to spend around a hundred, no more.

I understand your concerns about the price. But the Premium membership gives you access to all zones, group classes and a personal trainer, which is a lot of added value. Could you tell me what matters most to you in a gym membership?
Well, you know, a personal trainer and those classes are nice, but 159 is almost 60 zlotys more than I wanted to pay. That's a big difference for me.
I understand that difference matters to you. But the Premium membership is a complete solution that gives you full access to all facilities. Is there anything specific you care about most in a gym?
Look, I appreciate it, but I just don't have the budget for that much. I'll stick with my hundred, sorry.
I understand your decision, Piotr. Thank you very much for your time and the conversation. Have a nice day.
Okay, thanks. Have a nice day, bye!
Thank you too. Goodbye.

Yes, go ahead.
Hello, Michał. I'm calling with an offer for Home Insurance Plus. I'd like to give you the details of our offer.
Okay, but quickly, I don't have much time.
I understand. Our Home Insurance Plus is comprehensive protection for forty-nine zlotys a month on an annual contract. It covers many risks that could affect your property.
Okay, and what exactly does it cover?

The insurance covers, among other things, water damage, fire, burglary and vandalism. On top of that, the package includes home assistance, which means that in case of a breakdown, for example a plumbing one, you can count on quick help from a professional.
Hmm, okay. And what's the payout limit?

The payout limit depends on the insurance option you choose, which is tailored individually to the value of the property and belongings. As standard, we offer sums insured that cover most typical damage.
Okay, but specifically - how much is it? Some amount?

I understand you're interested in specific amounts. As standard, for a flat of average value, the sum insured can range from one hundred thousand to as much as five hundred thousand zlotys, depending on the scope of cover and the value of the belongings. The exact amounts are set after analysing your needs.
Okay, that sounds reasonable. So if I want to sign up, what do I need to do?
Michał, thank you for your interest. As discussed, I'll prepare detailed information about Home Insurance Plus covering the points we talked about. I'll send it to your email address.
Hey, but I asked how to sign up, not about an email. Do you want me to buy or not?

I understand your question. My job is to present the offer and give you all the information. As I mentioned, I'll send you detailed materials so you can calmly look through the terms of the insurance.
Okay, then there's probably no point talking further. Thanks, goodbye.
Thank you for the call, Michał. I'll send you that information then. Goodbye.
Hello, this is Ola. Am I speaking with Magdalena Grabowska?
Yes, Grabowska speaking.
Hello, Magdalena. I'm calling with a special offer on our CRM system for small businesses. I'd like to show you how it can streamline customer relationship management at your company.
Oh, a CRM... okay, go ahead, what's the offer?

We're offering our CRM system for small businesses for eighty-nine zlotys per user per month on an annual contract. It's a complete tool that will help you organise your work, manage contacts and make your sales more effective.
Hmm, 89 zlotys per user... and what about the implementation, how much does that cost?

The price of eighty-nine zlotys per user per month covers access to the system itself. Implementation is usually an individual process that depends on the company's needs, but we offer support and materials to help you set it up yourself.
Exactly, because I spoke to someone from your company before and they mentioned an amount for the implementation, something like two thousand zlotys. That's getting expensive, you know?

I understand your concerns. The two thousand zlotys you mention usually applies to a full, personalised implementation, which includes configuring the system for the company's specific needs and training. Many companies choose to implement it themselves with our support, which saves on the upfront costs.
Sure, but two thousand up front is still a lot, I have three kids and a tight budget. Besides, last week someone else called me with a similar system and offered it cheaper.

I understand budget is an important factor, especially with three children. Our system offers complete solutions that in the long run can save you a lot of time and increase efficiency. Could you tell me what exactly matters most to you in a CRM system?
Well, you know, two thousand for implementation is too much for me, that's my main problem. That other system was cheaper too, so... I don't know if this makes sense.

I understand the implementation cost is key for you. I'd like to stress that the two thousand zlotys is an option for companies that need very personalised support. Many of our customers choose to implement it themselves using our materials and technical support, which avoids that upfront expense. Could you tell me what exactly you found most interesting about that cheaper offer?
Well, that offer simply had a lower price per user, without extra costs up front. But mostly it's the two thousand for implementation that puts me off, it's too much at once.

I understand that two thousand zlotys up front is a lot and that it's the main barrier. I'd like to stress again that it's an option for those who need full support, but our system is intuitive and many companies successfully implement it themselves using our instructions and technical help, which eliminates that initial cost. Were there any specific features in that cheaper offer that particularly interested you?
Well, no, I'm not looking for any special features, it was just cheaper. But you know, the two thousand is really out of the question, my husband would kill me.

I understand your concerns and that an upfront amount like that is unacceptable for you. Since the implementation cost is the main obstacle and implementing it yourself isn't an option for you, is there anything else keeping you from considering our system?
Well, that's it, the two thousand is the main problem. Plus that other offer was simply cheaper per month, so I'll probably stick with that option.

I understand, Magdalena. Since the implementation cost is so important to you and another offer suits your budget better, I won't keep you any longer. Thank you very much for your time and the conversation. Have a nice day.
Okay, thank you, goodbye.
Thank you too, goodbye.

Oh, okay. So what kind of system is it and how much does it cost?
Sure. Our CRM system is a complete tool that will help you manage customer relationships, sales and marketing. As for the price, it's eighty-nine zlotys per user per month on an annual contract.
Hmm, 89 zlotys per user per month, I see. And what exactly does the system include?
The system includes contact management, interaction history, a sales module and basic marketing features. Everything you need to make work at a small company run more smoothly.
Okay, and how many users can I connect? Because we have about five people at my company.
You can connect any number of users, you only pay for each active user. So in your case it would be five times eighty-nine zlotys a month.
Okay, so about 445 zlotys a month, and per year that comes to over five thousand. Is there any way to test it before signing the contract?

Yes, of course. We offer a free fourteen-day trial so you can get to know the system and check whether it meets your expectations. And as for the price, let me remind you it's seventy-nine zlotys per user per month on a two-year contract.
Wait, wait. A moment ago you said 89 zlotys and an annual contract, and now suddenly it's 79 zlotys and two years? I don't know what I'd be signing anymore.
I'm terribly sorry for the slip, Krzysztof. My mistake. The correct offer is eighty-nine zlotys per user per month on an annual contract. Again, I apologise for the confusion.
Okay, I understand. But honestly, it worries me a bit that you mixed up the terms so easily. How can I be sure that what I sign will be right?

I understand your concerns and once again I'm very sorry for the confusion. I assure you that all the terms, including the price of eighty-nine zlotys and the annual contract, will be clearly and precisely set out in the written contract, which you'll receive to review before signing.
Okay, fine. So I get the contract in writing, look it over, and only then decide?
Exactly. You'll receive a draft contract to review, and after reading it you'll be able to make your final decision. Do you have any other questions about the system or the offer?
Okay, I think that's enough for now. Send over the contract and I'll think about it.

All right, Krzysztof. In that case I'll send the draft contract to the email address we have on file. If you have any questions after reading the document, please feel free to call. Thank you for the conversation and have a nice day.
Okay, thanks. I'll wait for the email. Bye.
Thank you very much, goodbye.

No, I really don't have time. I don't trust calls like this, I never arrange anything over the phone with strangers.
I understand, Zofia. Thank you for your time. In that case I won't keep you any longer. Have a nice day. Goodbye.
Okay, goodbye.
Goodbye.

It's our best membership, giving you access to all gym zones, group classes and the sauna. And all that for one hundred fifty-nine zlotys a month on a twelve-month contract.
Hmm, okay. And what if I want to cancel early, before the end of those twelve months?
Don't worry, everything is flexible and tailored to the customer. This membership is a really great opportunity to take care of your fitness and health. What do you think?
Well, you didn't answer my question. What exactly happens if I want to cancel before the end of the contract? Are there any penalties?

Don't be concerned, everything with us is very favourable for the customer. The Premium membership really is a complete solution that lets you enjoy full access to everything we offer. Do you have any specific training goals?

Natalia, there's really nothing to worry about, everything with us is very transparent and favourable. This membership is an excellent investment in your health and wellbeing. Is there anything keeping you from taking this exceptional offer?
Okay, then no. If you can't tell me what happens if I cancel early, I'm not interested. Goodbye.

I understand you need time to think. Is there anything specific still holding you back from deciding? Maybe the details of the offer, or the price itself?
Well, mainly the price. That other offer was simply cheaper, so I need to think it over.

No, I don't think so. I have to run and get the kids, I'll call when I decide.
All right, I understand. In that case, thank you for your time. If you have any questions or decide to take our offer, please feel free to call. Have a nice day and talk soon.
Okay, bye.
Goodbye.
